usageNotes: Retrieves a single named firewall alias defined at the LXC container level, returning its CIDR value and any comment. Use this to inspect or verify a specific alias before referencing it in firewall rules. Alias names must start with a letter and match the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+; the caller must hold VM.Audit on the container.

examples.summary: Read the 'WebBackend' alias on LXC container 110 hosted on node pve1

tips: Aliases defined at the container level are scoped only to that container's firewall — they are not shared with the node or datacenter alias pools.
If the alias name does not exist, the API returns a 500 error rather than a 404; handle accordingly in error logic.
Use the list endpoint (get_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_firewall_aliases) first to confirm an alias exists before reading it by name.
